column1: # Campaign 23 test evidence for the bounded TiPB signed-BIGINT Selection expression wire.

column8: note

dag_column_offset_and_literal_use_go_comparable_integer_bytes covers signed BIGINT constants including i64 MIN and exact FieldType bytes; NULL, unsigned, real, decimal, string, time, duration, JSON, vector, enum, set, binary-literal, and error vectors remain open.

dag_column_offset_and_literal_use_go_comparable_integer_bytes covers zero-based DAG ColumnRef offsets and BIGINT FieldType flags; index, virtual, collation, type-family, and broader column metadata cases remain open.

all_six_signed_comparisons_preserve_source_signatures_and_children plus operand_order_is_not_rewritten cover LTInt LEInt GTInt GEInt EQInt and NEInt for signed BIGINT; NULL-safe, string, real, decimal, temporal, duration, JSON, vector, collation, and unsupported-pushdown matrices remain open.
No LIKE conversion is implemented; this artifact proves only the bounded signed-BIGINT comparison converter and LIKE remains an explicit gap.
No arithmetic scalar-function conversion is implemented; this artifact proves only the bounded comparison converter and arithmetic signatures remain open.
No date or temporal scalar-function conversion is implemented; the signed-BIGINT comparison artifact does not discharge these vectors.
No logical scalar-function conversion is implemented; AND is flattened by the bounded planner rather than encoded here and the original logical-function vectors remain open.
No bitwise scalar-function conversion is implemented; the bounded comparison artifact leaves this original test open.
No control-flow scalar-function conversion is implemented; the bounded comparison artifact leaves IF IFNULL CASE and related vectors open.
No miscellaneous scalar-function family is implemented; the bounded comparison converter does not discharge this original test.
The TiPB projection preserves only the bounded Selection expression messages and comparison enums; JSON conversion and TiFlash pushdown policy remain unported.
The exact bounded wire tags are tested by selection_executor_and_nonnullable_defaults_keep_exact_wire_tags; general expression conversion and TiFlash capability policy remain open.
The bounded TiPB messages do not implement expression-only TiFlash pushdown or its allow and deny matrix.
unsupported_operator_fails_closed and the six signed-BIGINT converter cases cover only the Campaign 23 TiKV subset; the general TiKV pushdown matrix remains open.
Only the bounded signed-BIGINT comparison conversion is available; expression-only TiKV pushdown policy and all other function families remain open.
No GroupByItem message or conversion is in the dependency-closed projection; this original test remains open.
No ByItem sort conversion is in the dependency-closed projection; this original test remains open.
field_type_preserves_every_upstream_scalar_field_presence verifies encoded collation field presence only; collation rewrite and pushdown behavior remain open.
The bounded wire preserves FieldType.collate but does not implement new-collation enablement or compatibility policy.
field_type_preserves_every_upstream_scalar_field_presence covers only bounded FieldType scalar presence; general expression metadata propagation remains open.
No session or global pushdown switcher is implemented; the bounded converter accepts its six owned operators directly and leaves switch policy open.
unsupported_operator_fails_closed returns a typed error for the bounded converter; the source panic contract and general unspecified protobuf-code audit remain open.
ColumnRef offset and BIGINT flags are encoded for Selection operands; projection-column index remapping and broader schema behavior remain open.
